That evening he set a fresh lamp burning brighter than usual, folded the note into his coat, and resolved to find whatever family that distant voice had left behind.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市还在沉睡，街灯昏黄，照着空荡的马路。偶尔一辆出租车驶过，留下湿漉漉的轮印。便利店的灯依旧亮着，收银员打着哈欠。远处早点铺升起第一缕白烟，面香悄悄漫开。环卫工挥动扫帚，节奏缓慢而坚定。天边泛起一线淡青，鸟声零星响起。这座城市在黑暗与黎明的夹缝里，安静地呼吸，等待着被唤醒。", "w03": "- Imagine standing between two mirrors and seeing yourself repeat smaller and smaller forever.\n- Recursion is when something solves a problem by calling a tinier copy of itself.\n- It stops when the problem gets so small there's nothing left to solve, like reaching the last mirror."}
